sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Origin**: First demanded by M.N. Roy (1934); INC officially demanded it in 1935; accepted in principle by British via August Offer (1940) and Cripps Mission (1942).
• **Composition**: Constituted under the **Cabinet Mission Plan (1946)**. Total strength: 389 (296 British India, 93 Princely States).
• **Election Mechanism**: Indirect election by members of Provincial Legislative Assemblies using **Proportional Representation by means of Single Transferable Vote**.
• **Key Metric**: Seats allocated based on population (roughly 1 seat per 1 million population) divided among Muslims, Sikhs, and General categories.

items.definition: Moved by Jawaharlal Nehru on Dec 13, 1946; laid down the philosophy and guiding principles of the Constitution, later becoming the Preamble.
Set up on Aug 29, 1947, under Dr. B.R. Ambedkar; the most important committee responsible for scrutinizing the draft constitution.

items.title: Major Committees
items.content:
• **Union Powers Committee**: Jawaharlal Nehru.
• **Provincial Constitution Committee**: Sardar Patel.
• **Advisory Committee on Fundamental Rights**: Sardar Patel.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Communal divide, integration of Princely States, and balancing diverse regional aspirations.
• **Solutions**: Consensus-based decision making and inclusion of diverse ideological spectrums.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'UP-FR-S' (Union-Powers, Fundamental-Rights, States).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Nehru led Union/States committees; Patel led Fundamental Rights/Minorities committees.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: The Constituent Assembly was NOT directly elected by the people of India on the basis of adult franchise. It was indirectly elected.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Constitutional Morality' and 'Consensus-based Democracy' when discussing the Assembly's working style.

keyTakeaways: The Assembly was a sovereign body that functioned as both a constituent and legislative entity.
The Cabinet Mission Plan provided the structural framework for the Assembly's formation.
The Constitution was adopted on Nov 26, 1949, but came into force on Jan 26, 1950.
